scope: Twenty-four exact Book 44 tedy sites whose clause role is equivalence, apposition, or explanatory restatement.
choice: Replace only the selected token ordinals with branch-neutral to jest; preserve adjacent same-line conclusion markers.
motivation: German controls and local syntax show appositional or equivalence force rather than temporal sequence or inference. Ordinal binding separates mixed-function tokens occurring on the same line.
alternatives_rejected: zato would turn equivalence and restatement into conclusions.
togda would invent temporal meaning; the full audited tedy/teda family contains no genuine temporal-event use.
imenno is narrower than the selected equivalence and explanatory sites.

evidence.context_review: All 24 exact occurrences were classified against German appositional/equivalence controls; eight adjacent consequence ordinals were explicitly guarded.
evidence.representative_controls: Rank-one over K versus rank t^2 over P, direct-product and direct-summand restatements, Galois splitting-field equivalence, and matrix-ring equivalence.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: frozen hashes reproduced before atomic apply
